adds.rationale: NATO's newly-inked 5%-of-GDP defense-spending commitment and the resulting rearmament order backlog are a live buildup-phase catalyst for the profile's explicitly-named geopolitical wave, which currently has zero watchlist representation, and a broad US aerospace & defense ETF captures the primes named in the thesis without picking a single name.

news_evidence.summary: All 32 NATO members but Spain agree to raise defense/security spending to 5% of GDP by 2035 (3.5% core + 1.5% security-related)
Aerospace & defense ETFs XAR and ITA show sustained multi-year outperformance versus broad equities, reflecting the sector's ongoing re-rating through the rearmament cycle

removes.rationale: OKLO shows a classic unpriced peak-enthusiasm signal after its 2025 run -- Goldman initiated coverage at Neutral flagging a stretched valuation and capital-intensity risk the same week that the CEO, CFO, and a director all sold stock, which is exactly the trim-before-the-crest trigger the profile's wave thesis calls for even though the broader nuclear/SMR wave itself is intact.

news_evidence.summary: Oklo fell 16% over two days after CEO, CFO, and a company director each sold shares and Goldman Sachs urged caution on the stock
Goldman Sachs initiated Oklo at Neutral with a $117 price target, below the prevailing market price, citing unfinalized customer agreements and the capital burden of Oklo's build-own-operate model

rationale_overall: Net effect is a one-for-one thematic swap, not a size change: OKLO's peak-enthusiasm signal (insider selling into a fresh Goldman Neutral initiation, after a 500%+ 2025 run) argues for trimming the nuclear position now rather than waiting for a harder breach, while the vacated slot is redeployed into ITA to give the geopolitical/rearmament wave -- named explicitly in the profile but previously absent from this watchlist -- its first representation via a diversified US aerospace & defense ETF. The other four legs (MSFT/AI, RKLB/rockets, BOTZ/robotics, QTUM/quantum) all showed continued buildup-phase strength this quarter (record Microsoft cloud/AI earnings, Rocket Lab's Synspective launch deals, IonQ deals feeding the QTUM basket) and were kept as-is. Post-change wave buckets (AI, rockets_spacecraft, robotics, quantum, geopolitical) are each single-ticker, well inside the diversity guardrail.
